name: Kiribati
official: Independent and Sovereign Republic of Kiribati
snapshot: Atolls spread across an ocean area the size of India, among the most exposed to rising seas, governed by Taneti Maamau, who switched recognition from Taiwan to China.
culture: Kiribati spans three island groups and is the only country in all four hemispheres. The maneaba, a large meeting house, is the centre of village life and decision-making. Traditional dance, imitating frigate birds, is central to celebrations. Kiribati is among the first places to see each new day.
society: Most land is barely two metres above sea level, and saltwater intrusion threatens drinking water and crops. Fishing licences for its huge ocean zone provide most government revenue. Tarawa is very crowded. Some citizens migrate to New Zealand under special visa programmes.
baseline: Taneti Maamau won a third term in 2024. He switched recognition from Taiwan to China in 2019, and China has funded infrastructure and police cooperation. A plan to restart a WWII-era airstrip on Kanton Island with Chinese help has worried the US and Australia.
